description: Ministry of Prison Reforms Rehabilitation Resettlement & Hindu Religious Affairs - Order made to implement the Provision in Sec. II of the Community based Correction Act. No. 46 of 1999 concerning the Anamaduwa & Siyambalanduwa Judicial Divisions w.e.f. 01.01.2016
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Community Based Correction Act, No. 46 of 1999, specifying the implementation of provisions for certain Judicial Divisions. It is a legal/regulatory instrument that amends or provides specific implementation details for an existing Act, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters. While a minister is named, the primary purpose is not about the personnel change or their portfolio responsibilities, but about the legal order itself.
